firstTime.title: Your free WordPress
firstTime.subtitle: Setting things up… have a read while you wait.
firstTime.intro: This is a complete WordPress that runs in your browser: no sign-up, no hosting plan, no domain needed. It's not meant for public blogging. Instead, it's your own personal WordPress, where you can install apps that keep your stuff with you: reading lists, saved articles, contacts, conversations, and more. Your data lives here, and you can shape this WordPress however you like.
bullets: Running WordPress in the browser is unusual. It normally lives on a server. We've tried to make it behave just like a normally hosted WordPress, but you might run into the occasional oddity.

Look for the small Playground icon in the bottom-left corner. That's Site Tools. It's always there, floating above WordPress, and it's how you install apps, manage files, view logs, and restore backups.

Your WordPress downloads a backup every day, automatically (configurable in Site Tools). If your browser data ever gets cleared, this page will come back as a fresh WordPress. Open Site Tools and point it at your saved backup to restore your old site.
firstTime.bookmarkTip: ⭐ Bookmark this page. This is your WordPress now. Add it to your bookmarks so you can easily come back.

tips: Look for the small tab in the bottom-left corner to open Site Tools at any time.
You can bookmark any page. The browser URL always reflects where you are in WordPress.
Configure automatic backup downloads in Site Tools so you never lose your work.
You can install apps from the Site Tools sidebar to add new capabilities.
Paste a blueprint URL or JSON into the Site Tools panel to add a custom app.
Your site lives entirely in this browser. No server, no account needed.
Avoid reloading the page if you can. Just click around inside WordPress instead.

changelog.title: Seamless fullscreen
changelog.text: The toolbar is gone. Your WordPress runs in fullscreen, and the browser URL bar shows where you are.

changelog.title: Site Tools sidebar
changelog.text: Click the tab in the bottom-left corner to access files, database, logs, app installs, backups, and recovery.

changelog.title: Automatic backups
changelog.text: Configure daily or weekly backup downloads in the sidebar's About tab.

changelog.title: Install apps
changelog.text: Browse and install pre-configured apps from the sidebar, or paste any blueprint URL.
